# Dongfeng EV Trucks (dongfengevtrucks.com)

> Dongfeng EV Trucks is the new-energy commercial vehicle export platform of Shaanxi Fenghan Trading Co., Ltd. — authorized exporter of Dongfeng electric trucks from China. Products include electric tractor trucks (TE series), electric dump trucks (TZ series, KTA1), electric cargo trucks (KT5M/5J/5L, KTH series), and electric mixer/sanitary special trucks (KT3F/KT1D/KT3E/KT7A/TZ8J/KT9X, EU-standard). Key specs: CATL LFP batteries 262-600 kWh, LvKong motors 282-510 kW, range 200-350 km, battery swap in 5-6 minutes, 8-year/4500-cycle battery warranty. Export markets: West Africa, East Africa, Middle East GCC, Southeast Asia, Latin America, Central Asia, Europe.

## Products

- [Electric Tractor Trucks](https://dongfengevtrucks.com/products/electric-tractor.html): TE series — CATL LFP battery, for port and long-haul logistics
- [Electric Dump Trucks](https://dongfengevtrucks.com/products/electric-dump.html): TZ3V 8x4 600 kWh mining dump, TZ5E 6x4 400 kWh construction dump, KTA1
- [Electric Cargo Trucks](https://dongfengevtrucks.com/products/electric-cargo.html): KT5M/5J/5L, KTH series — urban and regional distribution
- [Electric Special Trucks](https://dongfengevtrucks.com/products/electric-special.html): KT3F, KT1D, KT3E, KT7A, TZ8J, KT9X EU-standard mixer and sanitary vehicles
- [FAQ](https://dongfengevtrucks.com/faq.html): EV truck range, charging time, TCO vs diesel, import questions

## Key Topics

- EV truck total cost of ownership (TCO) vs diesel
- CATL LFP battery safety and cycle life in electric trucks
- EV truck charging: 120kW / 240kW / 360kW and solar hybrid setups
- EV truck battery swap (CAS swap station) solutions
- West Africa port logistics with electric trucks (Lome, Tema, Abidjan)
- Carbon credits and EU Battery Regulation 2026 compliance for EV truck export
